plugins/nightshift/skills/archive.description: File a finished shift into its own archive folder, laid out like the live site, so the live files keep only open work.

plugins/nightshift/skills/customize.description: Show every setting, template and catalog entry on one screen, and change only what the owner names.

plugins/nightshift/skills/doctor.description: Read-only diagnosis of the workspace, rules, markers, lease, watchman and deadline, with classified next actions; never repairs anything.

plugins/nightshift/skills/hunt.description: Turn a request like "improve this project for 5 hours" into a shift from the ready catalog and start it, asking only for the hours when they are missing.

plugins/nightshift/skills/import-issues.description: Stage explicitly selected GitHub issues onto the drafting table as quoted source; never searches or writes back.

plugins/nightshift/skills/nightshift.description: Work a punch list to completion autonomously, overnight, through a todo list or until a product is polished, parking decisions instead of asking and leaving receipts.

plugins/nightshift/skills/plan-exit.description: Leave the plan room and name the next step toward building what was planned.

plugins/nightshift/skills/plan.description: Open the plan room to explore the code and design the work with the owner, building nothing until the owner leaves.

plugins/nightshift/skills/purge.description: Permanently delete this project's Nightshift state, including punch lists, rules, receipts and archives; does not uninstall the plugin.

plugins/nightshift/skills/quality.description: Compose a shift that works the project's quality debt across tests, code, accessibility, contracts, docs, dependencies and security.

plugins/nightshift/skills/reset.description: Drop the runtime markers and deadline after damaged or confusing runtime state, without deleting the owner's work or evidence.

plugins/nightshift/skills/schedule.description: Print the launchd, cron or Task Scheduler config that starts a shift at a fixed time; registers nothing.

plugins/nightshift/skills/setup.description: Scaffold .nightshift/ and propose quality gates for this stack in at most four questions, with every default on one screen; asks, never imposes.

plugins/nightshift/skills/start.description: Begin the shift from the punch list without asking, so scheduled and headless runs behave like interactive ones.

plugins/nightshift/skills/status.description: Read-only shift status covering items, parked decisions, snags, the deadline and STOP or stall state; starts no work.

plugins/nightshift/skills/stop.description: Issue a stop-work order that pauses the shift now and leaves unfinished items open.

skills/install-nightshift.description: Install the full Nightshift plugin, with its hooks and runtime, into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.
